title: Candidate Safety, Transparency & Fraud Prevention
intro: SLEDMC operates under strict principles of transparency and ethical conduct:
points: SLEDMC does NOT promise or guarantee employment or visas. Employment depends on direct employer selection, and visa issuance is governed by destination state laws.
Candidates receive clear, transparent information regarding employment conditions, salaries, working hours, and costs prior to any commitment.
Protect yourself against recruitment fraud. SLEDMC never requests payments to unauthorized personal bank accounts. Always verify communications through official SLEDMC channels.
